items.text: Yesu yaliisia abandu ebikhumila biraano
Olunyuma lwamakhuwa ako Yesu yasamula natsia injelekha weinyanza yaGalilaya, niyo eya Tiberia.
Omukanda omukhongo nikumulondakhwo, shichila balola ebilolelo ebia yakhola khubalwale.
Mana Yesu natikulukha mushikulu niyeekhalayo halala nende abeechibe.
Ne Pasaka, nilio lisabo liabaYahudi, liali ahambi.
Kho Yesu yachinguula tsimonitsie, nalola omukanda omukhongo nikumwitsila, nareeba Filipo ari Nakhukule heena emikaate, bano mana balie?
Ne yasunga ako khulwa okhumuteema; okhuba omwene yamanya eshia yeetsa okhukhola.
Filipo nakalusia, nasunga mbu Kata emikaate chietsitinari ebikhumi bibili shichibahela, buli mundu okhunyoolakhwo omutiiti, ta.
Mulala owokhubeechibe, mbu Anderea, omwana wabwe Simoni Petero, namusunjila ari
Aliho hano omuyia ouli nende emikaate chiraano chieishayiri nende tsinyeeni tsibili; ne ebio nabinyale shiina khubandu abanji bari nanwa?
Yesu naboola mbu Mwikhasie abandu. Ne bwaliho obunyasi obunji habwene yaho. Kho abasaatsa nibeekhala, obukhumi bwabwe shinga ebikhumila biraano.
Mana Yesu nabukula emikaate echio; ne namalile okhuupa Orio, yabakabila abali nibeekhaale; khandi nende tsinyeeni natsio tsirio, obunji shinga olwa beenya.
Ne olwa bali nibeekuure, yabiila abeechibe, ari Mukhung'aasie ebisonye ebitong'a, eshindu shiosi shileshe okhukora.
Kho nibabikhung'aasia, nibeetsusia ebimwelo ekhumi nabibili ebiebisonye biemikaate echio chiraano chieishayiri ebia abali nibaliile basikasia.
Ne olwa abandu abo balola eshilolelo eshio eshia yakhola, basunga mbu Toto mwene, uno nomunabii oyo owitsa mushialo.
Mana olwa Yesu yalola mbu beenya okhwitsa okhumuhamba namaani mbu bamukhole omuruchi, yaahukha khandi, natsia mushikulu omwene yenyene.
Yesu yachenda khumatsi
Ne khubwile abeechibe bakholomokha nibatsia khunyanza;
nibeenjila muliaro, nibachaaka okhwambukha munyanza okhutsia eKaperinaumu. Ne eshialo shiali nishiiliime, naye Yesu yali nashili okhuula ewa bali.
Nayo inyanza niyichaaka okhwirunda khulwa imbumbuyeka ikhongo eyali niyihuutsa.
Ne olwa bali nibafuchile eliaro shinga tsimailo tsitaru tsine, balola Yesu nachenda khumatsi, nasita ahambi nende eliaro, nibaria.
Naye nabasunjila ari ISIE NISIE; muraria tawe.
Kho nibachama okhumwinjisia muliaro; nebutswa habwenaho eliaro niliula khushialo eshia bali nibatsiayo.
Abandu bakhaaba Yesu

Ne mukamba abomukanda okwasinjila khulukuku Iweinyanza injelekha yilia balola mbu eliaro lindi libulaho, habula elala lionyene; khandi mbu Yesu shiyeenjiile muliaro halala nende abeechibe ta, habula mbu abeechi batsia bonyene.
Nebutswa amaaro karula eTiberia ahambi nende habundu tsana ewa bali nibaliile emikaate olwa Omwami yali nakhupiile mbu Orio.
Kho olwa abomukanda balola mbu Yesu shiyali naliho ta, kata abeechibe tawe, abeene beenjila mumaaro ako niboola eKaperinaumu, nibamukhaabanga Yesu.
Yesu niye eshiliibwa shiobulamu
Ne olwa bamunyoola nali injelekha weinyanza, bamureeba bari Rabi, witsile hano liina?
Yesu nakalusia nabasunjila ari Toto mwene, emusunjila mbu shimu'khaabanga shichila mwaluutsi ebilolelo ta, habula shichila mwaliile khumikaate nimwikura.

Murakhalabanila ebiliibwa ebisasikhanga ta, habula khulwa ebiliibwa ebio ebibeetsangaho okhuula khubulamu bwobumeli, ebia Omwana wOmundu alamuheelesia; okhuba niye owa Samwana, mbu Nyasaye, yarakhwo eshibalikho.
Kho nibamureeba bari Khukhole khurie, kho khukhole emilimo chiaNyasaye?
Yesu nakalusia nabasunjila ari Kuno nikwo omulimo kwaNyasaye, mbu mumusuubilile oyo owa yaruma.
Kho nibamureeba bari Mana neshilolelo shiina eshia okhola khulole nikhusuubila? Nimulimo shiina okwa okhola?
Abakuuka beefwe balia imana mushitsiimi; shinga olwa kahandiikwa, mbu Yabaheelesia ebiliibwa ebirula mwikulu mbu balie.
Mana Yesu nabasunjila ari Toto mwene, emusunjila mbu shiyali Musa owamuheelesia ebiliibwa ebirula mwikulu ta; ne Papa amuheelesinjia ebiliibwa biatoto ebirula mwikulu.
Shichila ebiliibwa biaNyasaye nibio bienebio ebiikhanga nibirula mwikulu, nibiheelesia eshialo obulamu.
Kho nibamusunjila bari Omwami, tsindaalo tsiosi okhuheelesinjie ebiliibwa ebio.
Yesu nabasunjila ari Isie nisie ebiliibwa biobulamu; owitsa khwisie shialalumwa inzala ta; nousuubilila isie shialaliibwakhwo obuloho tsindaalo tsiosi tawe.
Nebutswa ndamusunjila mbu mwayanduutsi, khane murashiasuubila ta.
Bosi aba Papa yambeelesia beetsa khwisie; noyo owitsa khwisie shindalamusukuna elwanyi nahatuutu ta.
Okhuba shindayeekha okhurula mwikulu okhukhola okokhwenya khwanje omwene ta, habula akokhwenya khwa oyo owaruma.
Ne kano niko aka yeenya owaruma, mbu khubosi aba yambeelesiye endeshe okhukosia kata mulala khubo ta, habula mbu emulamusie khunyanga yobumaliilishi.
Okhuba kano niko aka Papa yeenya, mbu buli mundu oumulola Omwana namusuubilila, abe nobulamu bwobumeli; nasi ndilimulamusia khunyanga yobumaliilishi.
Kho abaYahudi nibamubuutsuluulila, shichila yasunga mbu Isie nisie ebiliibwa ebieekha okhurula mwikulu.
Nibasunga bari Uno shiali ye Yesu, omwana waYusufu, owa khumanyile samwana nende nyina? Kho akhaboolanga arie bulaano, mbu Ndeekha nirula mwikulu?
Yesu nakalusia nababoolela ari Murabuutsuluula abeene nabeene ta.
Omundu yesi shianyala okhwitsa khwisie tawe, habula nakhweswa nende Papa owaruma; nasi ndilimulamusia khunyanga yobumaliilishi.
Kahandiikwa mukabanabii mbu Ne bosi baliechesibwa nende Nyasaye. Buli mundu owahulila nende okhweka akarula khuPapa, yeetsa khwisie.
Shikali mbu omundu yesi yakmulola Papa ta, habula oyo ourula ewaNyasaye, niye owamuluutsi Papa.
Toto mwene, emusunjila mbu ousuubila ali nende obulamu bwobumeli.
Isie nisie ebiliibwa biobulamu.
Abakuuka beenywe balia imana mushitsiimi, ne bamala nibafwa.
Bino nibio ebiliibwa ebiikhanga nibirula mwikulu; mbu omundu aliekhwo, aleshe okhufwa.

Isie nisie ebiliibwa ebilamu ebieekha nibirula mwikulu; omundu yesi naba nalia khubiliibwa bino, alamenya obushia nobushia; toto, kata ebiliibwa ebia ndalahaana khulwa obulamu bweshialo nibio omubili kwanie.
Kho abaYahudi nibayingana abeene nabeene, bari Omundu uno anyala arie okhukhuheelesia omubilikwe mbu khukulie?
Mana Yesu nababoolela ari Toto mwene, emuboolela mbu nimuba nimuraliakhwo khumubili kwOmwana wOmundu nende okhunywa khumabangake ta, obulamu shibubakhwo mwinywe tawe.
Ouliitsanga khumubili kwanje nanywa khumabanga kanje ali nende obulamu bwobumeli; nasi ndilimulamusia khunyanga eyobumaliilishi.
Okhuba omubili kwanje nikwo eshiliibwa shiatoto, khandi amabanga kanje niko eshiokhunywa shiatoto.
Ouliitsanga khumubili kwanje nanywa khumabanga kanje amenyanga mwisie, nasi muye.
Shinga Papa ouli nobulamu olwa yaruma, nasi shinga olwa embeetsanga nobulamu khulwa Papa, nilwo olwa oundiitsangakhwo ali, mbu alabeetsanga nobulamu khulwanje.
Bino nibio ebiliibwa ebio ebieekha nibirula mwikulu; shibili shinga ebia abakuuka abo balia, nibafwa, ta; oulia khubiliibwa bino alabeetsanga nobulamu obushia nobushia.
Amakhuwa kano yakasunga musinagogi, olwa yali niyeechesilinjia eKaperinaumu.
Amakhuwa khukobulamu bwobumeli
Kho abanji khubeechibe, olwa bakahulila, nibaboola bari Kano namasungo amatinyu; niwina ounyala okhukahulila?
Ne Yesu, namanyile mumwoyokwe shinga abeechibe olwa bakabuutsuluulila, yabasunjila ari Khane likhuwa lino limwisichirasiye?
Ne mwakhaba murie nimuba nimwakhalola Omwana wOmundu nakulukha nakalukha ewa yalinji khale?
Niroho eyihaananga obulamu; omubili shikukaasila eshindu ta; amakhuwa aka ndamusunjiile niko roho, khandi niko obulamu.
Ne balimwo abandi mwinywe abarasuubila ta. Okhuba okhurula khukhuchaaka Yesu yamanya abeenabo abarasuubila ta shinga olwa bali, nende oyo owitsa okhumukhoba.
Nabasunjila mbu Niko akachila nimusunjiile, ndi abulaho ounyala okhwitsa khwisie narali Papa oumunyalila ta.
Okhurula habwenaho abanji abokhubeechibe nibakalukha inyuma, nibaralondana ninaye khandi ta.
Kho Yesu nabareeba abo Ekhuminababili ari Neenyu, mwenya okhutsia noho?
Simoni Petero namukalusia ari Omwami, khukhatsie ewawina? Iwe oli nende amakhuwa kobulamu bwobumeli.
Neefu khwasuubiile nikhumanya shinga olwa oli Omutakatifu waNyasaye.
Yesu nabakalusia ari Shindamulobola inywe Ekhuminababili, ne mulala khwinywe nisetani?
Ne yali nasunga khuYuda waSimoni Isikariote, shichila neniye owitsa okhumukhoba, nali mulala khwIkhumi nababili abo.
